description: List the 2D overlay images available to studio_set_overlay: backgrounds (drawn behind everything, from DefaultData/bg and UserData/bg) and frames (drawn on top of everything, from UserData/frame). These are flat images, not the 3D map — use studio_search_catalog with catalog='map' for that. The 'path' of an entry is what studio_set_overlay takes.

query.description: case-insensitive substring matched against the image name and path

path.description: the value to pass to studio_set_overlay
